subject.title: [Feature]: Refresh direct provider catalogs for Qwen 3.7, North Mini Code, and Mistral Small 4

question: Should this protected maintainer-labeled provider catalog refresh stay maintainer-owned, or may the protected label be cleared so a normal catalog repair can proceed?
rationale: The requested change is bounded and source-reproducible, but the live issue has the protected `maintainer` label and is assigned, so ClawSweeper should pause for explicit maintainer intent rather than auto-queueing repair work.

options.title: Keep Maintainer-Owned
options.body: Leave the protected label in place and let the assigned maintainer or owner-sponsored PR handle the catalog refresh.

options.title: Clear For Repair
options.body: Remove or override the protected handling and allow a narrow automated repair that only changes provider-owned catalogs, docs, and focused tests.

options.title: Defer Catalog Refresh
options.body: Keep the issue open but postpone updates until model contracts or pricing stabilize further.

recommendation.title: Keep Maintainer-Owned
recommendation.body: Leave the protected label in place and let the assigned maintainer or owner-sponsored PR handle the catalog refresh.

likelyOwner.reason: The issue is assigned to steipete and carries a protected maintainer label, making him the best available owner for the workflow decision.
